lines.zh: 我扛着一门炮走，脚下很沉。
lines.en: I carry a cannon and walk heavily.
The barrel is longer than I am.
I make my way through the dark forest.
Pine needles sound under my feet.
I go around the trees; the barrel catches.

lines.zh: 我把炮管转过去，先探路。
lines.en: I swing the barrel forward to clear the way.
My armor is covered in scratches.
I keep the muzzle angled low.

lines.zh: 松针被炮管压出一条路。
lines.en: The barrel presses a path through the pine needles.

lines.zh: 那里视野不好，可我听得好。
lines.en: Bad sight lines there, but I hear well.

lines.zh: 我放下炮，听林子的动静。
lines.en: I set the cannon down and listen.
Then I go on.
I stand with the barrel forward.
My finger is near the trigger.
I haven't pulled it.
I'm waiting for something worth it.
Water drips from the trees.
It hits my armor and slides off.
I turn the muzzle slightly.
And turn it back again.
My arm is the muzzle.

lines.zh: 黑森林里，我守着这一条线。
lines.en: In the dark forest I hold this one line.
I've noted the drift.
I hold this field of fire.
The dark forest is dark to begin with.
Being here suits me.
I raise the muzzle half an inch.
I lift the muzzle.
You don't have to move aside.
I'm not planning to fire yet.
I'm looking at your gear.
It won't stop this.
Your shield will not stop this shot.
My barrel is heavy. I turn slowly.
Go sideways and you'll be clear.
You went sideways.
Going sideways is right.

lines.zh: 我扛着炮，把炮口挪过去。
lines.en: I shift the barrel around with my shoulder.
Remember which way my muzzle points.

lines.zh: 炮口始终不离你的胸口。
lines.en: My muzzle never leaves your chest.
If you circle, I'll turn.
I turn slowly, and I don't tire.

lines.zh: 我的护甲上多了一个坑。
lines.en: There's a new dent in my armor.
The barrel still points that way.
The cannon's still on my shoulder.
That doesn't stop me firing.
My armor is dented, but the mount holds.
Blood runs from the armor's seams.
I bite down on the pain.
I raise the muzzle.
I recalibrate the sight on the muzzle.
The cannon's still on my shoulder.
What's in your hand catches the light.
I angle the muzzle away a little.
I don't shoot at nothing.
That thing isn't worth a round.
Are you holding it up to bait me?
I count my rounds.
I still have rounds.
But I don't waste them.
That little glint is not worth a shot.
And we'll just stand here.
Ammo is limited; I do not fire wildly.
That's better for everyone.
You walk into the barrel.
The barrel knocked askew, I set it straight.
That'll bruise your hand.
I point the muzzle at the ground.
I don't want an accident.
You go past my flank.
I didn't stop you.
My armor pads me well.
Hitting me doesn't hurt.
You got the worst of it.

lines.zh: 我的肩甲比我的心思重。
lines.en: My pauldron is heavier than my feelings.
I'm more like a piece of equipment.
A cannon, a trigger, a target.

lines.zh: 我只和这门炮待在一起。
lines.en: I keep company with this cannon and nothing else.

lines.zh: 我见过别的数码兽成对。
lines.en: I've seen other Digimon pair off.
I watched from a distance.
Then I turned and left.
There's no room for that here.
I raise the barrel.
I've stayed here long enough.
I bend and my armor creaks.
Barrel still hot, shell in hand.
I fired that casing.
I put it in the pouch at my waist.
The pouch at my waist is heavy.
I count them. Two are missing.
I search the ground.
Found one.
The other rolled off somewhere.
I stop looking for the rest.
Something's behind the tree.
I swing the muzzle that way.
I kneel and steady the cannon.
I brace the cannon on a fallen log.
About forty paces.
Wind, one to the left.
I lift the whole gun.
That shoulder in the shadows moved.
I adjust a little.
It stops behind the tree.
I hold the gun and wait.
It'll come out.
I keep my eye on that trunk.
It shows part of itself on the other side.
The barrel needn't lift yet.
I adjust the angle.
This barrel is very heavy.
Moving it an inch takes a while.
It pulls back.
I hold the angle.
I count my breaths.
I count to three.
It came out from behind the tree.
Pulling the trigger, my shoulder drops.
The muzzle flashed once.
The whole wood goes white.
A row of trees falls.
The sound arrives much later.

lines.zh: 我从后坐力里退了两步。
lines.en: The recoil pushes me back two steps.
The soil is torn into a deep pit.
Through the smoke I raise the cannon and aim again.
It isn't there anymore.
There's blood spattered at the pit.

lines.zh: 尘土里看不清它去哪了。
lines.en: I can't tell where it went in the dust.
I swing the barrel round.
And this gun is too slow.

lines.zh: 我从黑森林的深处走出来。
lines.en: I come out of the dark forest's depths.
The cannon is on my shoulder. Heavy.
I set the butt on the ground first.
And rest a while.
The trees here are too thick.
I can't walk a straight line.
So I go around the trees.
Every step, the armor clanks.
My clanking drowns the birds.
Let it ring. I don't care.
I don't need to ambush.
I only need a clear field of fire.

lines.zh: 火燎到炮管，我把它按进土里。
lines.en: Fire catches the barrel and I press it into the soil.

lines.zh: 我从树冠上掉下来，砸穿了两层枝。
lines.en: I fall from the canopy through two layers of branches.

lines.zh: 水进了炮口，我不敢再开。
lines.en: Water got into the muzzle. I don't dare fire.

lines.zh: 炸响把我掀翻，炮飞出去了。
lines.en: The blast flips me and the cannon flies off.

lines.zh: 一枚东西打在护甲上，弹开了。
lines.en: Something strikes the plate and ricochets.

lines.zh: 一道光罩住炮口，它不响了。
lines.en: A light covers the muzzle and it won't fire.
I still have rounds. I've lost the strength.

lines.zh: 雷打在炮管上，我整身都通了电。
lines.en: Lightning strikes the barrel and current runs through me.
The cannon has no weight.
